label: Beta cell
note: Inside an Islet or Cluster. A cell is endocrine when a hormone, read over its own background in the image, clears the image's hormone level (the ordinary-tissue p99, lowered inside the objects to a 10% local false-discovery rate). The hormones are mutually exclusive (owner, 2026-10-18): it is named by its highest hormone on the cohort scale, here insulin, only when that hormone is at least twice the runner-up (Senior's confirmation margin); under the margin the cell is Excluded. A Single's one cell takes the same rule.

label: Alpha cell
note: As Beta cell, with glucagon the highest hormone.

label: Delta cell
note: As Beta cell, with somatostatin the highest hormone.

label: CHGA+ hormone-negative
note: Inside an Islet or Cluster: CHGA at or above the image's ordinary-tissue CHGA level (Senior's CD99 reference), and insulin, glucagon and somatostatin all measured and below the image's hormone level. Senior's Endo-hormone-negative (owner, 2026-10-18), called ahead of the immune rules.

label: Endocrine
note: Endocrine cell whose hormones were not all measured. Counted in every total; not listed as a phenotype beside Beta, Alpha and Delta.

label: CD8a Tcell
note: Immune T cell (CD3e >= 0.10 scaled, no epithelial marker) with Senior's T-CD8 subtype.

label: CD4 Tcell
note: Immune T cell with Senior's T-CD4-helper subtype.

label: T cell
note: T cell (CD3e >= 0.10 on the cohort scale, no epithelial marker) without a CD4 or CD8 subtype. Counted in every total; not listed beside CD8a and CD4 T cells.

label: B cell
note: Senior's Imm-B-cell with CD45 in place of CD79a, which this panel lacks (owner, 2026-10-17): CD20 and CD45 >= 0.10 on the cohort scale, no T-cell, macrophage or epithelial marker.

label: Macrophage
note: Senior's Imm-macrophage (includes its Mac-M2-like subtype: CD163 with LGALS3).

label: Immune
note: CD45-positive leukocyte that no rule names further on this panel (owner rule, 2026-10-16), or Senior's supporting tier (a bottom-tier immune marker >= 0.8715 on the cohort scale). Counted in every total; not listed as a phenotype.

label: Exocrine
note: The residual class: every other cell outside the endocrine objects (acinar, ductal, stromal, endothelial and neural cells are not separated; nerve, capillary and lymphatic structures are areas, not cell types). A residual cell inside an endocrine object is Excluded from analysis.
